title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
summary: In a future where people are engineered into castes and kept content with drugs and constant distraction, a discontented man and an outsider from a reservation challenge the order. Their visit forces the world to look at itself.
readIf: you like philosophical dystopias that ask whether comfort is worth giving up freedom for.
skipIf: you want a fast, character-led plot, since the book is closer to a satirical debate than a thriller.

pairings.reason: The famous counterpart, with control by fear and force instead of pleasure.
A quiet, aching story about a society that quietly accepts something terrible.
A modern young-adult spin on a seemingly perfect world with a hidden moral cost.
